blinding_guess.why: The code sends width/height/pixelformat via VIDIOC_S_FMT and notes the driver may change width and height (usb_cam.cpp:928), but the negotiated values are written only into init_device's by-value parameters (938-939); start() then sizes image_ from the requested image_width/image_height (1049-1050), the MJPEG decoder is initialised with the requested size before negotiation (1020), and the returned pixelformat is never checked, so a driver-adjusted format leaves the conversion of DQBUF buffers (process_image uses dest->width*dest->height) inconsistent with the actual frames.
